cases.title: Select Available Seats and Calculate Total Price
cases.description: Verify that clicking available seats toggles their selection, updates the selected seat count (data-testid='selected-count'), and correctly calculates the total price (data-testid='total-price') based on the default movie ticket price.

cases.title: Prevent Selection of Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that clicking on seats marked as occupied does not change their state, does not alter the selected seat count, and does not affect the total price.

cases.title: Dynamic Movie Selection and Price Recalculation
cases.description: Verify that selecting different movies from the dropdown (data-testid='movie-select') correctly updates the ticket price and recalculates the total price while maintaining the current number of selected seats.

cases.title: Deselect Previously Selected Seats
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an already selected seat removes its selection status, updates localStorage, and appropriately decreases both the selected seat count and the total price.

cases.title: Persistence and Recovery from Local Storage on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the webpage, the system retrieves 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' from localStorage, correctly restores the selected class on corresponding seats, sets the movie dropdown value, and defaults safely if localStorage is empty.

cases.title: Seat Legends and Status Distinction
cases.description: Verify that users can distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seats using the provided status legends (including data-testid='seat-select') and that occupied seats are properly rendered as non-interactive.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, covers all requirements comprehensively, and are fully testable based on the provided specifications.
All cases and expected behaviors align with the provided requirements and test IDs. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1: Testable behaviors include interacting with the seat map and movie dropdown, clicking available seats to mark them as selected, updating data-testid='selected-count', selecting a movie via data-testid='movie-select' with price values, calculating data-testid='total-price' as selected seats multiplied by ticket price, and preventing selection of occupied seats. Boundaries/Abnormal paths: clicking occupied seats must not change count or price; changing movies dynamically updates total price. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2: Testable behaviors include selecting specific movies ('The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', 'No Country for Old Men ($9)'), clicking available seats (e.g., data-testid='seat-1-1') to toggle selection, storing indices in localStorage, deselecting seats by clicking again. Boundaries/Abnormal paths: occupied seats cannot be selected or included in calculations; UI and localStorage must sync. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3: Testable behaviors include retrieving and applying localStorage keys 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' on page load, marking corresponding seats with 'selected' class, setting movie dropdown. Boundaries/Abnormal paths: if keys are missing, no seats are selected and dropdown defaults to the first option ('The Big Lebowski ($10)'). Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4: Testable behaviors include dynamic calculation of selected count (data-testid='selected-count') and total price (data-testid='total-price'), toggling 'selected' class on available seats, recalculating price on movie change while maintaining seat count, and decreasing count/price on deselection. Boundaries/Abnormal paths: preventing selection of 'occupied' class seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5: Testable behaviors include distinguishing seat states via legends (e.g., data-testid='seat-select'), non-interactive occupied seats, interactive available seats toggling selection, and updating count/price accordingly. Ambiguities: exact structure and values for seat legends and specific identifiers beyond data-testid='seat-select'.
